newsitem.title: USA: Buffets weighs future of 7 underperforming units.
newsitem.headline: Buffets weighs future of 7 underperforming units.

text.p: Restaurant operator Buffets Inc said Wednesday it expects to finalize in the third quarter its assessment of about seven restaurant locations that have incurred negative cash flows on a year-to-date basis in 1997.
The company said it is considering options for these locations including expanding advertising or conversion to a different brand or concept. It did not identify the locations.
Buffets operates 357 restaurants, including 247 Old Country Buffet, 106 HomeTown Buffet and four Roadhouse Grill units.
